summary: Both occurrences place inward thought beside spoken words. Psalm 39 traces the movement from silence through musing to speech. Psalm 5 asks Yahweh to understand even the musing.

senses.definition: David asks Yahweh to hear his words and understand what he is musing. In Psalm 39 he describes his heart growing hot as he muses, before he finally speaks.

note: The two verses leave open how audible the musing is. The similar-sounding הגה can describe murmuring or meditation and has its own entry. No separately attested Hebrew verb or securely identified cognate is claimed for הגג.
